assumptions: The convergence owner supplies camera and scale transition state.
limitations: Current orbital phase is not canonical in P3 and is never claimed by this provider.
Orbit radii are logarithmically compressed presentation geometry.
Unintegrated lane code does not own selection, scale, camera, resource admission, or renderer composition.

fidelity.validity: Inspectable 3D presentation of P3 hierarchy and baseline orbit organization; not an ephemeris.
fidelity.resolution: Bounded stars, planets and 24..256 polyline samples per orbit.
fidelity.uncertainty: Ascending node, periapsis orientation and display anchor phase are deterministic presentation-only values.
